caption:
Step size 1.90 works. 2.05 throws it all away.

A model learns by rolling downhill on its error. At step size 1.00 the ball hits the bottom in 1 step.

At 1.90 it bounces wall to wall and still gets there in 30 steps.

At 2.05 every bounce lands higher. The ball flies off the map. Nothing at 1.90 warns you.
